「在耶路撒冷、犹太全地和撒马利亚，直到地极作我的见证。」全书二十八章就是这句话的: “In Jerusalem, in all Judaea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.” The twenty-eight chapters are that sentence unfolding: the first seven never leave Jerusalem, the eighth reaches Samaria, the thirteenth leaves Syria, and the last one stops in rented rooms in Rome.

与小亚细亚海岸只隔一条窄水道的岛，南下的第三夜。: An island separated from the Asian mainland by a narrow channel — the third night southward.
东地中海的老牌航运岛，往叙利亚的航路必经。: A long-established shipping island of the eastern Mediterranean, on every route towards Syria.
个采样点，由 GMRT 网格服务一次取得。 海岸线不另取矢量，而是由高程本身划出: points in all, fetched from the GMRT grid service in a single request. There is no separate coastline vector: the dataset carries bathymetry, and the builder writes every negative elevation outside the Jordan rift as zero, so the zero-metre contour is the shore; land is floored at 1 m so a low-lying coast is never mistaken for water. Inside the rift the real depth is kept, which is what holds the Dead Sea and the Sea of Galilee as water. The provincial borders for c. AD 50 and the ancient place names are educational approximations; the route lines follow the order of calls given in Acts, taking the Roman road or the most plausible sea passage between two points rather than a surveyed track.
亚比乌大道上距罗马六十公里的驿站。罗马的弟兄听见消息，一路走到这里迎接，保罗见了: A posting station on the Appian Way sixty kilometres short of Rome. The brothers in Rome heard he was coming and walked all this way to meet him; when Paul saw them he thanked God and took courage.
亚细亚省的首城，亚底米神庙所在地。保罗在推喇奴的学房天天辩论两年，全亚细亚都听见: First city of the province of Asia and home of the temple of Artemis. Paul argued daily in the hall of Tyrannus for two years until all Asia had heard; the riot Demetrius the silversmith stirred up packed the city into a theatre seating twenty-five thousand.
从海边到高原的那一段: The stretch from the shore to the plateau
从耶路撒冷下迦萨的路穿过旷野。腓利在这条路上遇见埃塞俄比亚太监，福音由此指向非洲: The road down from Jerusalem to Gaza runs through open desert. On it Philip meets the Ethiopian official, and the gospel turns towards Africa.
他们想赶去过冬的良港，却在半路遇上「友拉革罗」的狂风。: The better harbour they were making for to winter in, when the wind called Euraquilo caught them on the way.

保罗为赶在五旬节前到耶路撒冷而越过以弗所，把长老请到这里。这是他在全书中唯一一次: Hurrying to reach Jerusalem by Pentecost, Paul sailed past Ephesus and sent for its elders instead. It is the only time in the book he addresses church leaders; when he finished he knelt and prayed with them, and they fell on his neck and kissed him.
保罗独自从特罗亚步行三十公里翻山到此，再上船与同伴会合。: Paul walked the thirty kilometres over the hills from Troas alone and rejoined the ship here.
全书的终点，也是「直到地极」的象征。保罗自费租房住了两年，戴着锁链接待所有来见他: The end of the book, and the stand-in for the ends of the earth. Paul lived two years at his own expense in rented rooms, receiving in chains everyone who came. Luke never tells us how he died — only that the gospel went out in the heart of the empire with no one to stop it.
全书的起点与轴心。五旬节的火焰、最初的团契、司提反的殉道、耶路撒冷会议，都发生在: The hinge of the whole book. The fire of Pentecost, the first common life, Stephen’s death and the Jerusalem council all happen in this hill city seven hundred metres up. Each of Paul’s three journeys ends by coming back here; the last time he does, he is arrested.
列斯波岛的主城，沿岸南下的一夜停泊处。: The chief town of Lesbos, an overnight anchorage on the run down the coast.
别加在海平面附近，彼西底的安提阿在一千二百米的高原上，中间隔着陶鲁斯山与强盗出没: Perga sits near sea level and Pisidian Antioch twelve hundred metres up, with the Taurus and its bandit-ridden passes in between. Once the first journey was over that wall, the weight of the mission shifted from coastal towns to inland colonies.
加拉太省的首府。保罗两次「走遍加拉太和弗吕家一带地方」，坚固众门徒。: Capital of the province of Galatia. Twice Paul “went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia”, strengthening the disciples.
北非的希腊化城市，有很大的犹太侨民社群。最早向外邦希利尼人传福音的，正是古利奈人: A Greek city of north Africa with a large Jewish community. It was men of Cyrene and Cyprus who first preached to gentile Greeks.
博斯普鲁斯海峡口的城。保罗第二次旅程想往庇推尼去，「耶稣的灵却不许」，路线因此折: The city at the mouth of the Bosphorus. On the second journey Paul tried to go into Bithynia, “but the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them”, and the route bent instead towards Troas and Europe.
厄格那提大道上的另一站，同样只是路过。: Another stage on the Egnatian Way, likewise only passed through.
厄格那提大道上的驿站城，二人经过而未停留。: A staging town on the Egnatian Way that the two passed through without stopping.
古代地中海的航期大致从五月到十月。保罗的行程被这条季节线切成段：第三程赶在五旬节: The ancient sailing season ran roughly from May to October, and that line cuts Paul’s travels into stages. The third journey raced to reach Jerusalem by Pentecost; the ship for Rome left after the Fast, met a gale south of Crete, and spent the whole winter on Malta.
司提反殉道后教会四散，腓利下到撒马利亚城传道，行邪术的西门在此受洗。这是福音第一: After Stephen’s death the church scatters and Philip goes down to preach in the city of Samaria, where Simon the sorcerer is baptised. This is the first time the gospel crosses a Jewish boundary.
吕家的大港。保罗一行在此换上直航腓尼基的大船，离开沿岸跳岛的小船，横渡开阔海面。: The great harbour of Lycia. Here the party left the island-hopping coaster for a ship sailing straight to Phoenicia, across open water.
哥林多的东港。保罗在这里剪了头发还愿，然后开船去叙利亚。: Corinth’s eastern harbour, where Paul cut his hair for a vow before sailing for Syria.
哲学之城，政治上已经衰落。保罗见满城的偶像心里着急，在亚略巴古从「未识之神」的坛: The city of the philosophers, politically long past its best. Provoked by the idols everywhere, Paul begins from the altar to an unknown god — the one speech in the book addressed to a purely gentile audience.

Acts is a book about going out — turn this sea around and watch each of Paul’s four journeys reach further than the last.

埃及运粮船北上的固定停靠港。百夫长在此找到一只亚历山大来的船，把囚犯换上去。: A regular call for the Egyptian grain fleet. The centurion found a ship of Alexandria here and moved his prisoners aboard.
基利家的首府、著名的学术之城，也是保罗生长之地。他从耶路撒冷避难回到这里，多年后: Capital of Cilicia, a noted university town, and where Paul grew up. He retreats here from Jerusalem, and years later Barnabas comes looking for him.
墨西拿海峡口的港。等到南风起，一天一夜就到了部丢利。: The port at the mouth of the strait of Messina. When the south wind came up it was a day and a night to Puteoli.
夏天走海，冬天不走: Sail in summer, not in winter
外邦宣教的母会: The mother church of the gentile mission
大道上更近罗马的一站，另一批弟兄在这里等他。: A stage further along the road towards Rome, where another party was waiting for him.
奥林匹斯山北麓的小城。这里的人被称为比帖撒罗尼迦人更贤明，因为他们甘心领受，还天: A small town under the north flank of Olympus, whose people are called more noble than the Thessalonians because they received the word readily and searched the scriptures every day.
安提阿的外港，在奥龙特斯河口。第一次宣教旅程从这里下船。: Antioch’s harbour at the mouth of the Orontes, where the first journey went aboard.
安纳托利亚高原上的会堂之城。二人在此住了多日，直到城里的人要用石头打他们才离开。: A synagogue town on the Anatolian plateau. The two stayed a long while, until the city moved to stone them.
小亚细亚西南角的岬角港。船行得慢，到这里已经被逆风顶住。: A headland port at the south-west corner of Asia Minor. The ship had sailed slowly, and by here the wind was against it.
居比路岛东岸的大城。巴拿巴的家乡在这座岛上，第一次旅程从这里的犹太会堂开讲。: The main city on the east coast of Cyprus. Barnabas came from this island, and the first journey opened in its synagogues.
居比路的省会。行法术的以吕马受责成了瞎子，方伯士求保罗信了道。从这一章起，路加改: The provincial capital of Cyprus. Elymas the magician is struck blind and the proconsul Sergius Paulus believes. From this chapter on Luke calls Saul “Paul”, and the lead of the story changes hands.
希律大帝建的人工深水港，罗马巡抚的驻地。哥尼流在此受洗，腓利在此定居，保罗在此被: Herod the Great’s artificial deep-water port and the Roman governor’s seat. Cornelius is baptised here, Philip settles here, Paul is held here two years, and from here he takes ship for Rome.
帝国的粮仓与犹太学术重镇。亚波罗从这里来，载保罗去意大利的两艘运粮船也都属于这座: The empire’s granary and a centre of Jewish learning. Apollos came from here, and so did both grain ships that carried Paul towards Italy.
帝国第三大城，人口约五十万。门徒在这里第一次被称为「基督徒」。三次宣教旅程都从这: The third city of the empire, with perhaps half a million people, and the place where the disciples were first called Christians. All three journeys set out from here and report back here.
扼守地峡的双港商城，亚该亚省会。保罗与亚居拉、百基拉一同做帐棚，在此停留一年半—: A two-harbour trading city astride the isthmus, and capital of Achaia. Paul made tents with Aquila and Priscilla and stayed a year and a half, longer than anywhere else. The proconsul Gallio threw out the charges against him, and the inscription naming Gallio is one of the fixed points of New Testament chronology.
押送保罗的船离开该撒利亚后的第一站。百夫长犹流准他上岸见朋友。: The first call after leaving Caesarea. Julius the centurion let Paul go ashore to see his friends.

放胆传讲，无人禁止: Preaching boldly, no one forbidding him
旁非利亚的主要海港，第一次旅程由此坐船回安提阿。: The chief harbour of Pamphylia, where the first journey took ship for Antioch.
旁非利亚的内陆城。约翰马可在此离开他们回耶路撒冷，这件事后来让保罗与巴拿巴分道。: An inland city of Pamphylia. John Mark left here and went back to Jerusalem — the thing that later split Paul from Barnabas.
沙漠边缘的绿洲大城，也是全书的转折点。扫罗在近城的路上被光照倒，三日不能看见；亚: A great oasis city on the desert edge, and the pivot of the book. On the road near it Saul is thrown down by a light and cannot see for three days; Ananias lays hands on him, and he escapes over the wall in a basket.
河边与狱中: By the river and in the jail
沿海平原与山地之间的路口小城。彼得在此医治瘫痪八年的以尼雅。: A junction town between the coastal plain and the hills, where Peter heals Aeneas, bedridden eight years.
海拔一千二百米的罗马殖民城，从别加上来要翻越陶鲁斯山。保罗在会堂里讲了全书最长的: A Roman colony twelve hundred metres up; reaching it from Perga means crossing the Taurus. Paul preaches the longest sermon in the book in its synagogue, and on being driven out says, “we turn to the gentiles”.
漂流十四天后触礁的岛，二百七十六人无一丧命。岛上土人生火接待他们，保罗被毒蛇咬却: The island they struck after fourteen days adrift, with all two hundred and seventy-six aboard coming through alive. The islanders lit a fire for them, a viper bit Paul without harming him, and he healed the chief man’s father. The ship’s company wintered here three months.
爱琴海东侧的大岛，船在对面抛锚过夜。: A large island on the east side of the Aegean; the ship lay off it for the night.
爱琴海东岸的罗马殖民港。保罗夜间看见马其顿人求他过去帮助——福音由此跨过爱琴海进: A Roman colony and harbour on the east shore of the Aegean. Here Paul sees a Macedonian begging him to come over, and the gospel crosses into Europe. Luke’s narrative also switches to “we” for the first time.
爱琴海北部的高耸岛屿，过海的船在此停一夜。: A steep island in the northern Aegean where the crossing lay over for a night.
犹太人的老港口。彼得在硝皮匠西门家的屋顶上看见那块降下的大布，随后动身去外邦人哥: The old Jewish harbour. On the roof of Simon the tanner’s house Peter sees the sheet let down, and then sets out for the house of a gentile — the threshold of the church is moved here.
瘸腿的人被医好，众人以为宙斯和赫耳墨斯降临，要献牛给他们；几日后同一群人用石头把: A lame man is healed, the crowd takes them for Zeus and Hermes and brings oxen to sacrifice; days later the same crowd stones Paul and drags him out of the city. Timothy’s home was here.

离开米利都后一路直行的第一站。: The first stop on the straight run after leaving Miletus.
第一次旅程最东的一站。传了福音、门徒众多之后，二人不走近路回大数，而是原路折返坚: The furthest point east of the first journey. Having made many disciples, the two did not take the short road home to Tarsus but doubled back to strengthen each church.

罗马兵连夜押送保罗从耶路撒冷到该撒利亚，中途在此换班。: The night march that took Paul from Jerusalem to Caesarea changed escort here.
罗马的弟兄迎上来: The brothers come out to meet him
罗马的粮食门户，那不勒斯湾内的大港。保罗在此遇见弟兄，被请住了七天，之后走亚比乌: Rome’s grain gateway, the great port inside the bay of Naples. Paul found brothers here and was asked to stay seven days before taking the Appian Way up to the capital.
罗马退伍军人的殖民城，城里犹太人少到没有会堂。卖紫色布的吕底亚在河边信主；保罗和: A colony of Roman veterans with too few Jews for a synagogue. Lydia, a dealer in purple, believes by the river; Paul and Silas are beaten and jailed, and at midnight, while they sing, the earth shakes and the jailer’s household is baptised.
腓利为太监施洗后，被提到亚锁都，沿海岸一路传福音直到该撒利亚。: After baptising the Ethiopian, Philip is found at Azotus and preaches his way up the coast as far as Caesarea.
腓尼基南端的良港。保罗末次上耶路撒冷时在此停留一日。: A good harbour at the southern end of Phoenicia, where Paul stopped a day on his last journey up to Jerusalem.
腓尼基的古老海港。船在此卸货七日，门徒和妻子儿女送保罗到城外，众人在沙滩上跪下祷: The old Phoenician seaport. The ship unloaded for seven days, and the disciples with their wives and children walked Paul out of the city and knelt down on the beach to pray.
腓立比的外港，也是福音登上欧洲大陆的第一个落点。: The harbour of Philippi, and the first place the gospel touched European soil.
行程阶段筛选: Filter by stage of the journey
被当作神，又被石头打: Taken for a god, then stoned
西西里东岸的大港，开春后北上的第一站，停了三天。: The great harbour on the east coast of Sicily, the first call of the spring passage north; they stayed three days.
距耶路撒冷一个安息日的路程。门徒在此领受「直到地极」的差遣，全书余下的地理就是这: A sabbath day’s walk from Jerusalem. Here the disciples are sent “to the ends of the earth”, and the rest of the book’s geography is simply that sentence being worked out.
载保罗离开该撒利亚的第一艘船的船籍港。: The home port of the first ship that carried Paul out of Caesarea.
革哩底南岸的小湾，靠近拉西亚城。禁食的节期已过，航行有险，保罗劝他们就地过冬；百: A small bay on the south coast of Crete, near the town of Lasea. The Fast was already past and sailing had turned dangerous, so Paul urged them to winter where they were; the centurion believed the owner rather than Paul.
革哩底岛东端的海角，船绕过它到背风的南岸。: The cape at the eastern end of Crete, rounded to reach the sheltered southern shore.
风暴中的小岛: A small island in the storm
风暴中船贴着这座小岛的背风面掠过，水手趁机收起救生的小船，用缆索捆住船底。此后十: Running under the lee of this small island in the storm, the crew got the ship’s boat aboard and passed cables under the hull. Fourteen days of drifting followed.
马其顿的省会与大港。保罗一连三个安息日在会堂辩论，城里骚动，控告他们说「那搅乱天: The provincial capital of Macedonia and a great port. Paul argued in the synagogue three sabbaths running until the city rioted and the charge was laid: “those who have turned the world upside down have come here too”.
